name: Тёмный отсек: один тёплый источник
about: Почти чёрный кадр: рабочая лампа или подсветка пульта вырезает фигуру и стол из темноты, в иллюминаторе холодная синева. Металл угадывается по бликам, а не по контуру.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; a near-black interior where one warm practical lamp carves the figure and table out of darkness, a cold blue starfield in the porthole behind, metal read through highlights rather than outline, amber and gunmetal against deep blue-black
